description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nuwarawewa, East Nuwaragampalatha D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110190
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Nos. 64, 65, and 68) with detailed property descriptions, cadastral map references, and ownership information. The content focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
